title: Extension by zero on the localizing categories
statement:
Work in the standing scheme setting of [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]: fix a prime $\ell$ and a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and let $j\colon U\hookrightarrow X$ be an open immersion of separated finite-type $k$-schemes. Let $\Lambda$ be an admissible coefficient ring of [sk-def-localizing-closure]: a finite commutative ring killed by a power of $\ell$, or one of $\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E,\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, where $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite inside a fixed algebraic closure and $\mathcal O_E$ is its valuation ring. Regard these as condensed rings with their indicated topologies. Use the ordinary unbounded module-object derived categories $D(\Mod_{\Lambda_T})$, where $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$, and the bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategories $\Dctf(T,\Lambda)$ of [sk-def-sfb-constructible], for $T=U,X$.
Then extension by zero $j_!=D(j_!)$ maps $\Dctf(U,\Lambda)$ into $\Dctf(X,\Lambda)$, preserves all small direct sums on the ambient derived categories, and restricts to an exact, sum-preserving functor
$$
\Loc(\Dctf(U,\Lambda))\longrightarrow\Loc(\Dctf(X,\Lambda)).
$$
The localizing closures and their direct sums are taken in the ordinary ambient derived categories as in [sk-def-localizing-closure].

proof.text: The exact additive module-object extension by zero induces the triangulated functor J = D(j_!) by [lem-sf-exact-functor-derived-triangulated]. Its existing cohomology comparison identifies H^n(J K) with j_! H^n(K), so the existing bounded_mapDerivedCategory_obj lemma preserves boundedness. Use the derived adjunction already constructed from [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]; its left adjoint J preserves colimits of every discrete shape by [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits], including empty and larger-indexed existing coproducts.

proof.text: Apply [det-def-localizing-closure-existence] to the generating predicates on U and X. It supplies the actual localizing closures as replete triangulated subcategories and supplies the ambient small coproducts. For the final restriction, closure under object-universe existing coproducts implies closure under each smaller Discrete I by the equivalence with Discrete (ULift I). Mathlib full-subcategory inclusions therefore create and preserve these coproducts.

proof.text: For a bounded constructible finite-Tor object K, boundedness follows from step 1. The standing finite-type scheme U is qcqs, so its constant-model constructibility hypothesis supplies an actual Scheme.Stratification of each H^n(K). Copy the stratification fields into a finite locally closed stratification, retaining the constructibility proof separately. Apply [lem-sf-open-extension-zero-constant-model-constructible] to those fields and the finite constant local models. That declaration gives constructibility of j_!H^n(K). Transfer the same stratification and scalar models along the inverse-image images of the cohomology isomorphism from step 1. This gives constantModelBoundedConstructible for J K.

proof.text: Use the existing proved source-library open projection comparison isIso_openImmersionProjectionComparison (WeilConjectures.PoincareDuality.ProjectionFormula) for arbitrary commutative condensed coefficients; this is the open special case of the argument in the source locally closed projection-formula argument. Given a Tor interval [a,b] for K and any module M on X, the exactness comparison Lj^*(M[0]) ≅ D(j^*)(M[0]) ≅ (j^*M)[0] identifies the Tor test object. The projection comparison yields J(K tensor Lj^*(M[0])) ≅ J K tensor M[0]. The source Tor hypothesis and homologyConcentratedIn_mapDerivedCategory_obj show the first object concentrated in [a,b]; transfer across the isomorphism. The same interval works for every M, without an integral Dctf=Dbc assertion.

proof.text: Implement directly the defining intersection argument of [sk-def-localizing-closure]. The inverse image under J of the target localizing closure is triangulated and replete by Mathlib inverse-image instances. It is closed under every existing object-universe coproduct because J is a left adjoint: transfer the target closure property across preservesColimitIso. Step 4 maps every generator into the target generators and hence into their closure. Evaluating membership in the source intersection on this inverse-image candidate gives the required object map h. The canonical lift is triangulated by the Mathlib lift instance. Both inclusions create and preserve the smaller-indexed coproducts by step 2; their composite with J preserves them, and the target inclusion reflects them, proving preservation by the lift.

proof_origin.place: Formal properties, Constructibility, Finite Tor amplitude and Localizing categories; X5 Lean implementation using the proved open projection comparison and the closure intersection directly

Turns the existing sheaf-level open adjunction into preservation of all small coproducts; this is a generic categorical tool.

lean.statement: theorem openImmersionLowerShriek_localizing (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (_hp : 0 < p) (_hpℓ : p ≠ ℓ) (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}) [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ] (_hΛ : IsLocalizingAdmissibleCoefficient ℓ Λ) {U X : Scheme.{u}} [U.Over (Spec (.of k))] [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (U ↘ Spec (.of k))] [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] : (∀ K : ConstantModelConstructibleFiniteTor Λ U, (constantModelBoundedConstructible Λ X ⊓ fun L ↦ DerivedCategory.finiteTorAmplitude _ L) ((CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj)) ∧ (∀ I : Type (u + 1), PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) (CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory) ∧ ∃ (_ : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ U).IsTriangulated) (_ : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).IsTriangulated), ∃ h : ∀ K : (localizingClosureProEtale Λ U).FullSubcategory, localizingClosureProEtale Λ X ((CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K.obj), ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).lift ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ U).ι ⋙ (CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory) h).IsTriangulated ∧ ∀ I : Type (u + 1), PreservesColimitsOfShape (Discrete I) ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ X).lift ((localizingClosureProEtale Λ U).ι ⋙ (CondensedRing.openImmersionLowerShriek Λ j).mapDerivedCategory) h)
